headline_findings: EAGLE-3, DFlash/DFlash-2 and DSpark speculative decoding all merged upstream in the window (2-4x datacenter speedups, greedy-lossless; MoE and long-context gains are smaller).
Hybrid/recurrent models (Qwen3.5/Gemma4) gained speculative checkpointing and prompt-cache fixes, but carry crash and VRAM traps on 8 GB GPUs.

Router multi-model mode, built-in tools + MCP stdio servers, mtmd audio/video, and a critical RPC RCE fix (b11000) are the other harness-relevant changes; Windows CUDA 13.4 zips are the baseline asset.

items.fit_reference_machine: High: draft GGUFs (~1-2 GB) fit beside a 30B MoE on 8 GB VRAM + 32 GB RAM; verify accept rate on 3070 Ti since MoE verify fires extra experts.
items.harness_integration: Spawn with -md <draft.gguf> --spec-type draft-eagle3; autotune --spec-draft-n-max 3-8 per model; log accept rate; fall back to draft-simple/ngram on low acceptance.
items.name: EAGLE-3 speculative decoding
items.quality_cost: None under greedy decoding (verified drafts, output identical); sampling preserves target distribution.
items.reported_gain: 2-3x tok/s reported on LLaMA-8B class, e.g. 121 to 274 t/s Q4_K_M quicksort (RTX 4090-class, batch 1, greedy).
items.what: One-layer autoregressive draft model reading target hidden states; higher acceptance than a standalone draft of equal size.
items.where_implemented: llama.cpp merged PR #18039 (commit 88a3927); flag --spec-type draft-eagle3 with -md draft GGUF

items.fit_reference_machine: High for dense 4-14B; moderate for 30B MoE (parallel verify cost). Draft stays bf16/Q8_0 (~1-2 GB).
items.harness_integration: Spawn with -md <DFlash.gguf> --spec-type draft-dflash --spec-draft-n-max <= block size; combine with ngram-mod; disable on image turns (issue #27408).
items.name: DFlash block-diffusion drafting
items.quality_cost: None under greedy decoding (verified drafts); sampling preserves distribution.
items.reported_gain: Up to ~8x claimed on Qwen3; Qwen3-8B bf16 geomean ~2.9x vs baseline across 5 domains (RTX 4090, batch 1, greedy, PR data).
items.what: Small block-diffusion draft emitting a whole token block per forward pass with target hidden-state injection; GPU-friendly drafting.
items.where_implemented: llama.cpp merged PR #22105; flag --spec-type draft-dflash; drafts e.g. z-lab/Qwen3-*-DFlash

items.fit_reference_machine: High: 1.1 GB Q4_K_M draft for 27B target; best for predictable code/reasoning continuations; cap n-max at 7.
items.harness_integration: Serve target plus -hfd incoai draft GGUF with --spec-type draft-dflash --spec-draft-n-max 5; verify merge status via --help before allowlisting.
items.name: DFlash 2 parallel drafting
items.reported_gain: 2.26x end-to-end (68 to 154 t/s) on Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M, optimum n-max 5, hard cap 7 (independent study, discrete-GPU server, batch 1).
items.what: Non-autoregressive DFlash successor with local convolutions and candidate selector; one parallel draft step per block.
items.where_implemented: llama.cpp PR #27342 (merge reported 2026-08-27, verify in build); same --spec-type draft-dflash path

items.fit_reference_machine: High for Qwen3 4B/8B/14B targets on 8 GB VRAM; Qwen3-backbone drafts only so far.
items.harness_integration: Spawn with -md <DSpark.gguf> --spec-type draft-dspark --spec-draft-n-max 7; optional --spec-draft-conf-min only at high concurrency with unified KV.
items.name: DSpark Markov-head drafting
items.quality_cost: Greedy-lossless by construction (drafts verified vs target).
items.reported_gain: 1.88x overall vs baseline and 1.21x over DFlash on Qwen3-8B bf16 SPEED-Bench (RTX 4090, greedy); Q4_K_M geomean 1.81x (PR data).
items.what: DFlash plus a semi-autoregressive low-rank Markov head biasing each block position on the previously sampled token.
items.where_implemented: llama.cpp merged PR #25173 (2026-07-28); flag --spec-type draft-dspark; drafts deepseek-ai/dspark_qwen3_*_block7

items.fit_reference_machine: Critical for Qwen3.5/Gemma4 on this laptop; cap --ctx-checkpoints 1-2 and --parallel 1 to avoid the 150 MB-per-checkpoint VRAM trap.
items.harness_integration: Pass --ctx-checkpoints N and --spec-use-checkpoints on for hybrid archs; monitor for persistent slowdown (restart recovers); disable spec on image turns.
items.name: Speculative checkpointing for hybrid/recurrent models
items.quality_cost: None on output; rejected drafts cost one extra target forward (replay from checkpoint).
items.reported_gain: Makes speculation possible on SSM hybrids (e.g. ~20 to 24-30 t/s on Qwen3.5-122B-A10B + 0.8B draft, M3 Max, PR report); turn-2 prefill 12K to ~tens of tokens.
items.what: Checkpoint/restore of SSM recurrent state enabling speculative decoding and prompt-cache reuse on DeltaNet/Mamba hybrids.

items.fit_reference_machine: Very high: zero VRAM, ~16 MB RAM, shared across slots; ideal default for coding/agent repetition on a small office box.
items.harness_integration: Add --spec-default (ngram-mod) to the default argv allowlist; expose n-match/n-min/n-max tunables; stack with one draft model type.
items.name: ngram-mod default speculation + spec-type family
items.quality_cost: None (verified drafts); only speed varies with text repetitiveness.
items.reported_gain: Workload-dependent; up to ~5-9x on highly repetitive code prompts, ~1.3-2x typical mixed (independent DFlash study host numbers, batch 1).
items.what: Zero-model hash-pool n-gram drafter shared across server slots, selectable with other spec types via --spec-type list and --spec-default.

items.fit_reference_machine: High: replaces hand-rolled model swapping; pin --models-max 1-2 on 8 GB VRAM; group requests by model to avoid reload churn.
items.harness_integration: Spawn router (no -m) with --models-dir plus INI presets carrying per-model ngl/ctx/spec flags; drive /models/load and unloads from the supervisor.
items.name: Router multi-model serving mode
items.quality_cost: None on quality; model switch costs a full unload/reload per worker.
items.reported_gain: No tok/s gain; eliminates process restarts (first request pays load time); eviction races fixed in b11114.
items.what: Multi-process llama-server dispatching by request model field with on-demand load and LRU eviction behind one endpoint.

items.fit_reference_machine: High for a coding-agent harness, but treat as privileged: localhost-only, subset of tools, approval UX; never expose beyond the laptop/office.
items.harness_integration: Keep OFF by default; opt-in argv adds --tools read_file,grep_search,... with --cors-origins localhost; spawn MCP stdio children only from user config, never model text.
items.name: Built-in tools plus MCP stdio servers
items.quality_cost: Model-dependent tool-use accuracy; wrong-tool calls possible without approval gates.
items.reported_gain: No tok/s gain; enables file/shell/MCP tool loops locally; CORS default tightened to localhost when enabled.
items.what: Experimental server-side file/shell tools (/tools, --tools/--agent) plus Cursor-JSON MCP stdio servers merged into the same tool surface.

items.fit_reference_machine: High: any-model tool use via Jinja templates suits small-business automation; vision tool results need a VL target plus mmproj.
items.harness_integration: Expose --jinja and template selection in config; pass vision tool outputs via function_call_output with image payloads on VL models.
items.name: Universal tool calling with image tool results
items.quality_cost: Template-dependent: wrong Jinja template degrades tool-call accuracy; verify per model.
items.reported_gain: No tok/s gain; b11112 adds input_image in function_call_output enabling vision tool-result turns.
items.what: Function calling for approximately any model plus image-capable function_call_output for vision tool results.
items.where_implemented: llama-server; PR #22575 / issue #20663 (b11112); Anthropic Messages and responses API compat

items.fit_reference_machine: Moderate: mmproj defaults to GPU offload, competing with LLM layers for 8 GB; use --no-mmproj-offload or small VL models (Gemma4-E2B, SmolVLM).
items.harness_integration: Spawn with --mmproj <file> or -hf bundle; budget mmproj VRAM in the autotuner; force --spec-type none on multimodal turns.
items.name: mtmd audio/video input plus new model coverage
items.quality_cost: Modality quality is model-bound; OCR models need exact prompt structures per linked discussions.
items.reported_gain: No tok/s gain; new usable prequants: Gemma4 family, Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B, Qwen3-ASR, Voxtral-Mini-3B, five OCR models.
items.what: libmtmd image/audio/video input in llama-server and CLI with official pre-quantized GGUF plus mmproj bundles.
items.where_implemented: llama.cpp libmtmd; flags --mmproj, --no-mmproj-offload, --no-mmproj; multimodal.md model list

items.fit_reference_machine: Very high: q8_0/q4_0 KV plus Hadamard rotation is the main lever for large ctx on 8 GB VRAM; already in the harness flag set.
items.harness_integration: Keep -ctk/-ctv in allowlist with per-model defaults (q8_0 safe, q4_0 for long ctx); leave rotation on; skip requantize until merged.
items.name: Quantized KV cache with Hadamard attention rotation
items.quality_cost: Small perplexity cost at q8_0/q4_0 on tolerant models; rotation reduces degradation vs naive quants.
items.reported_gain: 2-4x KV memory cut (q8_0 ~2x, q4_0 ~3.6x) enabling 2-4x context on the same VRAM; minor decode-speed effects.
items.what: Low-bit KV cache types with Hadamard rotation on K/V plus SWA sliding-window and mixed-precision cache design.

items.fit_reference_machine: High once merged: start sessions at q8_0 KV and step down instead of restarting the server when context fills.
items.harness_integration: Watch PR #24367; until merged, approximate by restarting the child at lower -ctk/-ctv and replaying the prompt.
items.name: Online KV-cache requantization endpoint
items.quality_cost: Lower KV precision late in session; exact degradation unverified.
items.reported_gain: No steady-state tok/s gain; avoids full model reload plus prompt reprocessing when stepping KV precision down.
items.what: PoC POST /cache/requantize plus llama_requantize_memory rebuilding the KV cache at new k/v types without reloading weights.

items.fit_reference_machine: Low direct impact on Ampere (no Ampere-specific kernels in window); gains come free with the official CUDA 13.4 build.
items.harness_integration: No new flags required; re-baseline the official build; keep MTP/speculative flags since CUDA-graph-for-MTP-draft helps those paths.
items.name: CUDA path improvements (fused QKV, graphs, streams)
items.quality_cost: None; correctness fixes plus graph/streaming efficiency.
items.reported_gain: Unquantified per-kernel uplifts on modern NVIDIA GPUs (batch-1 laptop numbers not published); fused QKV fixes Gemma4/Qwen35 split correctness.
items.what: Fused-QKV split fix for Gemma4/Qwen35, CUDA graphs for MTP draft, im2col access tuning, concurrent streams per split.

items.fit_reference_machine: Critical: the office laptop must move off pre-b11000 RPC builds; keep the update check opt-in and offline-first as designed.
items.harness_integration: Pin minimum backend build to b11000+ in the hardware probe; never expose RPC/server to LAN without API key plus reverse proxy.
items.name: RPC RCE fix plus CORS hardening
items.reported_gain: No tok/s gain; closes unauthenticated remote code execution via cached compute-graph use-after-free.
items.what: b11000 discards cached RPC compute graphs on buffer free; --tools/--agent flips CORS default to localhost with explicit overrides.

items.fit_reference_machine: High: Qwen3.5/Gemma4 hybrids are the current quality frontier for this laptop; gpt-oss MXFP4 needs no Q4_K_M hunt; DFM-Mimir is a 1B side option.
items.harness_integration: Add arch strings (qwen35, gemma4, gpt-oss, dspark/dflash drafts) to model detection; map MXFP4 as the native precise gpt-oss format.
items.name: New architecture coverage (Qwen3.5, Gemma4, gpt-oss, DeepSeek-V4, Mimir)
items.quality_cost: Model-bound; hybrid archs carry the checkpoint/spec caveats above; tensor-split hybrids can assert (issue #21765).
items.reported_gain: No runtime gain; unlocks current models: Qwen3.5 MoE/dense, Gemma4 E-series, gpt-oss-20B/120B MXFP4, DeepSeek-V4, DFM Mimir 1B.
items.what: Upstream model support plus NVFP4 wiring for Qwen3.5 and speculators-format DSpark checkpoint conversion.

items.name: TurboQuant 3-bit KV cache
